_comment: Source of truth for HOST-side (Linux/KVM hypervisor) crash-correlation signals that are invisible from inside the Windows guest. src/scripts/collect-host-signals.sh reads this file to know which kernel-log patterns to grep for and which guest VM features to extract from the domain XML.

kernelLogSignals.meaning: Intel split-lock detection raised an #AC (Alignment Check) on a misaligned atomic that crossed a cache line, inside a KVM vCPU thread. On certain Intel platforms this is forwarded as a fatal NMI and crashes the guest (HYPERVISOR_ERROR 0x20001). Kernel-space trap addresses (0xfffff8xx) point at the Windows Hyper-V enlightened TLB-flush hypercall path.

kernelLogSignals.pattern: KVM: entry failed|kvm.*internal error|disabled perfctr wrmsr
kernelLogSignals.meaning: KVM reported a VM-entry failure or internal error. Can accompany a guest bugcheck when guest state was corrupted (e.g. by an NMI delivered mid-hypercall).

hypervEnlightenments.name: tlbflush
hypervEnlightenments.meaning: Hyper-V enlightened remote TLB flush. Exercises a misaligned-atomic hypercall path that can trigger split-lock HYPERVISOR_ERROR on affected platforms. Disabling it (native IPI-based invalidation fallback) is a validated mitigation.

hypervEnlightenments.name: ipi
hypervEnlightenments.meaning: Hyper-V enlightened inter-processor interrupts. Part of the same enlightened path; disabled alongside tlbflush in the validated mitigation.

hypervEnlightenments.name: reenlightenment
hypervEnlightenments.meaning: Hyper-V TSC re-enlightenment notification. Not a direct trigger but part of the enlightenment surface area.

hypervEnlightenments.name: vapic
hypervEnlightenments.meaning: Hyper-V virtual APIC. Not a direct trigger but part of the enlightenment surface area.

hypervEnlightenments.name: spinlocks
hypervEnlightenments.meaning: Hyper-V spinlock enlightenment. Not a direct trigger but part of the enlightenment surface area.

hypervEnlightenments.name: synictimer
hypervEnlightenments.meaning: Hyper-V synthetic timers (libvirt element stimer, with the .direct sub-feature). Not a direct trigger but part of the enlightenment surface area.
